lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: Hello again! What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You didn't record the railway on your survey.

lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: The railway… I definitely don't remember there being a railway…

lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: I do seem to remember a workforce clearing trees, though.

lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: I'm sorry, I hope this doesn't reflect too poorly on my abilities.

options.text: I understand, thank you for being honest.
A railway is a pretty big thing to miss…
